About Us

Built by people who know the sports surface industry

Hard Court Marketing was founded on a simple premise: sports surface contractors and manufacturers deserve marketing that understands their industry.

Every marketing agency targets clubs and facilities, but nobody helps the contractors who build the courts. We changed that.

We combine deep industry knowledge with cutting-edge marketing technology. Our team includes former sports facility owners, contractor business experts, and digital marketing specialists who understand the unique challenges and opportunities in the sports surface industry. We don't just know marketing -- we know your market.
